title: Trailer Vibes Lite
description: Low end version of Trailer Vibes to get more FPS
body:
![Trailer Vibes Lite logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/82228070ff5f023b6e6808eac3799d4f69fbb3c1.png)
-----------

### This modpack is a **low end** version of [Trailer Vibes Client](https://modrinth.com/modpack/trailer-vibes-client) !

On Trailer Vibes Client I get 150fps, on this one **280fps** (gallery images)

-----------

🔁 Switch between 2 resource pack profiles ! [Profile 1](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/7PBUYl01/images/1a50c73fd48c1edb949235b64436d4ef5f4467d2.png) keeps Bare Bones style, [Profile 2](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/7PBUYl01/images/1ee37f852c3984ddd30635d477c97c66d9078db0.png) adds some 3D stuff !

☀️ Choose _**BSL Shaders**_ or _**Complementary Reimagined + Euphoria Patches**_ to light up your world !

• Or select the "No Shaders" resource pack profile to get even more FPS ! (see gallery images)

------------
